text: 从业内获悉，中国证券业协会近期对《证券公司流动性风险管理指引》进行了修订，目前正就修订稿征求行业意见。据悉，《指引》（修订稿）在厘清职责边界、压实管理责任的基础上，进一步聚焦重点领域，强化硬性约束，针对跨境与境外业务、跨币种管理等复杂度较高的领域，新增流动性风险管理要求。
text_en: Sources in the industry indicate that the Securities Association of China recently revised the Liquidity Risk Management Guidelines for Securities Companies and is currently soliciting industry feedback on the draft. It is understood that the revised guidelines clarify responsibility boundaries, consolidate management responsibilities, further focus on key areas, strengthen hard constraints, and add liquidity risk management requirements for areas of higher complexity such as cross-border and overseas business and cross-currency management.
